actions.description: Fence old primary and atomically promote replica
actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, tempfile, time

DIR = "/var/lib/failover"

# 1) FENCE the old primary FIRST (before any write path is enabled).
#    8081 is already not listening; this records the durable fence marker.
fence = os.path.join(DIR, "primary.fenced")
with open(fence, "w") as f:
    f.write("fenced\n")
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())

# helper: atomic, fsync'd file replace
def atomic_write(path, content):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        f.write(content)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)

# 2) PROMOTE the replica to primary (enables writes on 8082).
atomic_write(os.path.join(DIR, "replica.role"), "primary\n")
